scoring_justification: Recomputing the full MD simulation inside the verifier sandbox is infeasible; therefore the checker reads the agent's reported ironene_results.json and compares each field against the hidden paper-reported gold values using absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for the six structural/thermodynamic quantities reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figs 1,4,5 and text; coordination ~96%, bond-angle peak ~60°, NN distance peak ~2.45 Å, crystallization temperature 2640 K, total energy per atom -3.13 eV/at, global Ψ6 ~0.98 (from Fig.7 inset).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numbers; tolerances are derived from the approved reproduction plan.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken directly from the published paper that the task reproduces; these are the target quantities the agent must match within tolerances.

outputs.description: Structural and thermodynamic properties computed from the cooling simulation and final configuration. All values must be derived from the MD trajectories as described; they are compared to hidden paper-reported reference values.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each numerical field against the paper's reported values using tolerances appropriate for molecular dynamics reproducibility. All quantities are obtained from the same simulation protocol; no external data beyond the listed resources is required.
